_comment: Issue #46 canonical: [Invisibility]'s COMBAT read, live through real input. Loads near_invisibility_combat (mage L5, floodplains (30,16) facing down, met_relc ABSENT so goblin_encounter_1 fields no ally -- pc solo vs goblin_raider (melee)/goblin_shaman (ranged), giving the AI-exclusion proof its deterministic 'exactly one valid target' shape). Route mirrors combat_walkthrough's own real trigger of this same ambush (down4 -> (30,20), outside the Chebyshev-2 zone -- down1 crosses in and fires it for real). Kit order (known_skills: basic_cleaning, then mage L1/L2/L5 grants in level order) -> combat hotbar Attack(1)/Dash(2)/frost_bolt(3)/flame_jet(4)/flame_dart(5)/invisibility(6)/End Turn (quick_cast/mana_shield stay ap_cost 0, no numbered slot; light is field-only; class-foundation R2 (#93) added [Flame Dart] to mage L2's grants, right after flame_jet, shifting invisibility from slot 5 to slot 6). Arena goblin_ambush_tutorial seats pc at (2,3), goblin_raider/goblin_shaman at (9,3)/(9,4) -- Chebyshev 7 apart, with a wall at (5,3) forcing a 1-cell detour, so closing to melee range for proof (3) below takes real movement, not an assumed adjacency. Proof, in order: (1) casting invisibility (hotbar_6) self-targets (skill_resolved target==pc), applies the invisible status with first_seen glossary text surfacing on the combat feed (status_applied.first_seen==true), same idiom status_first_encounter established for slowed; (2) ending the turn lets BOTH enemies act automatically (combat_playback's live AI-turn driving, not a QA-only mechanism) -- neither can target the sole player-side combatant while it's invisible, so zero attack_resolved fire and neither enemy (checked by actor id, not by target -- pc's own self-cast skill_resolved already has target==pc and would false-positive a target-keyed check) ever casts a skill before turn_started{pc} returns control; (3) pc walks the detour, double-dashes (WICombat.dash() is repeatable while AP lasts -- DASH_GAIN 3/use, spending 2 of its 4 AP to cover the remaining ground in this SAME turn) into melee range and lands a real Attack (hotbar_1) that immediately clears the status (status_expired{id:pc,status:invisible}) -- break-on-damage, live, well inside the 3-round duration window (still round 2), so this is unambiguously the break rule and not natural expiry; (4) the very next enemy turn (goblin_raider, immediately after pc's in turn_order) CAN target pc again -- attack_resolved fires whether the swing hits or misses, so its bare presence (not an exact count -- goblin_shaman may also act before pc's turn comes back around) is the honest proof the exclusion was temporary, not a permanent immunity. Ends mid-combat right after that proof, same deliberate convention as combat_move_input.json -- this solo-pc-vs-2-enemies matchup (no ally, by design, for the AI-exclusion proof's one-target shape) is never claimed winnable via combat_autoplay's melee-only PC profile, so this script doesn't force a victory finish. Snapshot() never exposes a `statuses` dict (only events do -- status_applied/status_expired, the same idiom ice_floor_loop/status_first_encounter already use for slowed), so this script proves the invisible status purely through those events and through AI behavior, never through an invented assert_state path. rng_state: near_invisibility_combat's own seed-9 derivation, empirically verified live (see that fixture's _comment).

steps._comment: Move down to the 'Continue' row, confirm loads the near_invisibility_combat manual slot.
(30,16) -> (30,20): 4 open steps south, still outside goblin_encounter_1's Chebyshev-2 zone around (30,23) (dist 3).
One more step crosses into the trigger zone (dist 2) and fires the ambush for real -- no ally fields (met_relc absent), so pc is the SOLE player-side combatant.

quick_cast/mana_shield (ap_cost 0) and light (field-only) never occupy a numbered slot -- Attack/Dash/frost_bolt/flame_jet/flame_dart/invisibility/End Turn = 7 (class-foundation R2, #93, added [Flame Dart] to mage L2's grants).

(1) Cast [Invisibility] on self (hotbar_6, shifted from 5 by class-foundation R2's flame_dart addition) -- self-target plumbing (Tab/cycle no-op, confirm resolves target_id==pc), same as [Stealth]/[Second Wind].
steps.name: hotbar_6

steps._comment: The status surfaces on the combat feed/readout: status_applied carries first_seen + the L1-generated glossary text (wi_game.gd's _enrich_status_applied), same surface status_first_encounter proved for slowed. (No assert_state on the status dict here -- snapshot() never exposes `statuses`; the event above, plus the AI-exclusion behavior proven next, ARE the proof.)

(2) End turn: BOTH goblin_raider (melee) and goblin_shaman (ranged) get a turn, each with pc as their ONLY possible foe -- neither can pick an invisible sole target, so control returns to pc having attempted nothing at all. Checked by ACTOR id, not by target: pc's own invisibility self-cast above already logged a skill_resolved with target==pc, and assert_event_absent audits the WHOLE run (qa/test_driver.gd), so a target-keyed check would false-positive on that earlier event.
steps.name: end_turn

steps._comment: (3) pc's own turn, still round 2: goblin_raider sits 7 cells east along row 3 behind a wall at (5,3) -- detour up to row 2 (right,right,up), double-dash (repeatable while AP lasts) to cover the remaining ground, drop back to row 3 and land a real melee Attack (hotbar_1). The instant it deals damage, break-on-damage clears invisible.
steps.name: move_right

steps._comment: First dash: 1 AP for +3 move pool (WICombat.DASH_GAIN), confirm-gated same as combat_move_input.json's own dash proof.
steps.name: hotbar_2

steps._comment: Second dash, same turn (dash has no cooldown/once-per-turn gate -- WICombat.dash()'s own doc comment: 'Repeatable while AP lasts'). Slot 1 is ALREADY the selected hotbar entry from the first dash above, so re-pressing hotbar_2 is a no-op selection (no fresh ui_slot_info_rendered -- that event only fires on a selection CHANGE); wait_frames instead of a second slot_info wait.
steps.name: hotbar_2

steps._comment: Adjacent to goblin_raider at (9,3) now (Chebyshev 1) -- Attack has a real target.
steps.name: hotbar_1

steps._comment: (4) End turn: invisibility is gone, so goblin_raider's very next turn (still round 2, immediately after pc's in turn_order) CAN target pc for real -- attack_resolved fires whether the swing hits or misses, so bare presence is the honest proof the exclusion was temporary, not a permanent immunity. Every proof this script exists for is now banked -- ending mid-combat here, same deliberate convention as combat_move_input.json ('Ends mid-combat on purpose... no victory assert'): this is a DELIBERATELY hard solo-pc-vs-2-enemies matchup (no ally, built to give the AI-exclusion proof its one-target shape), never claimed winnable via combat_autoplay's melee-only profile, so forcing a victory finish here would be asserting something this fixture was never designed to guarantee.
steps.name: end_turn
